transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um, well... I guess I'm just having some trouble focusing lately. Like, at work... I make jewelry, and I just can't keep my mind on one thing. I'll be at the bench, and then I'm checking an email, and then I see a saw mark I need to fix, and then I hear something outside... and by the time I look back, I've completely lost the work order. It's just... hard to stay on track.
Did you have this kind of trouble focusing when you were a child?
Uh... I don't think so. Not really. I mean, school was fine, I guess. I just... I don't remember it being like this back then.
Have you had a period where your mood was unusually high or irritable?

Um... I guess so. After a show recently... I don't know, I just felt really lit up. Like, larger than life for a minute. But... yeah, I guess I was getting annoyed easily, too. If anyone asked me to stick to normal shop hours, or told me to slow down... I kind of snapped at them.
During that lit-up period, did you need less sleep than usual?

Yeah... I suppose so. For a while there, I was only sleeping... maybe two or three hours a night. 

But I didn't feel tired. I'd wake up completely clear-headed and just... ready to go, way before sunrise. I'd get right to cutting stones, or... putting up new designs online. I just didn't really need the rest, I guess.
During that time, were you more driven than usual to start or work on projects?

Yeah... I guess I was. I just... I had a lot of ideas. I started taking on new commissions, reaching out to old customers... I was trying to map out a whole new website. And I was sketching this new Appalachian collection, all at the same time. It just felt like I needed to get everything going right then.
During that lit-up period, did your behavior cause serious problems in your life or work?

I mean... yeah, some things slipped. I ended up missing a major custom delivery, which wasn't great. And the shop records got pretty disorganized... to the point where I just had to stop taking on new work for now. Just to try and fix it. 

And... my family's been checking on me a lot more, too. I guess they got worried about how far I'd gotten from my normal routine. So... yeah. It caused some issues.
About how many days did that lit-up period last?
I guess... it was about two weeks. It all started right after I got an award at this jewelry show, and... yeah, it just went on for about two weeks like that.
